title: How a Simple Ticket Turned into a Complete Nightmare
description:
► One of Everything Bundle [Limited time]
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On March 25, 2023, an officer witnessed a fight breaking out in front of a bar in Tomah, WI. After discovering one of the men involved was not welcome at the establishment, police decided to issue him a citation. However, upon hearing this, the man tried to make an escape, leading to his arrest. Officers then had to deploy OC spray to gain compliance, making it a particularly difficult night for him.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
